title: Meta deal will help plastics recycling startup MacroCycle build its first factory
summary: Meta has partnered with plastics recycling startup MacroCycle to help fund construction of its first commercial manufacturing facility, expanding efforts to scale plastic recycling operations. The deal demonstrates Meta's commitment to environmental sustainability initiatives alongside its core business.
content: Meta is giving plastic recycling a boost in a new deal with startup MacroCycle, which is building its first commercial plant.

zh.title: Meta的交易将帮助塑料回收创业公司MacroCycle建设其首个工厂
zh.summary: Meta与塑料回收创业公司MacroCycle合作，帮助资助其首个商业制造设施的建设，扩大塑料回收业务的规模。这笔交易展示了Meta在继续推进其核心业务的同时对环保可持续发展的承诺。

title: Can you forget how you feel about Meta?
summary: The Verge examines Meta's approach to child safety through private conversations between Mark Zuckerberg and an advisor, revealing the CEO's ambivalence about prioritizing youth protection over metaverse development. The article questions whether public perception of Meta's motives can shift amid ongoing child safety controversies.
content:
In 2021, as a whistleblower emerged with dramatic allegations that Facebook was harming children, CEO Mark Zuckerberg posted a rebuttal on Facebook. “We care deeply about issues like safety, well-being and mental health. It’s difficult to see coverage that misrepresents our work and our motives,” he wrote in a note to Meta staff, which he reposted publicly. “At the most basic level, I think most of us just don’t recognize the false picture of the company that is being painted.”
Away from the stream of often inane public replies, one reader didn’t like what they saw. Zuckerberg spoke with the unidentified person privately on WhatsApp, according to exhibits later released as part of a series of lawsuits, and the figure urged Zuckerberg — a parent himself — to make child safety even more central in his messaging. “i am not saying facebook is duplicitous and evil,” they wrote. “i am saying the opposite, you have heard the chorus and will PERSONALLY make this issue over adolescents your issue.” 
In the privacy of the conversation, Zuckerberg was candid. “I care deeply about this and we’ll continue focusing on being industry-leading with young people,” he responded, “but I’m not going to say it’s my personal main focus when I have a number of other areas I’m more focused on like building the metaverse.”
Zuckerberg later reiterated that “I personally care about this.” But he appeared ambivalent, nudging his conversation partner away from older concerns and toward his vision for the future. “How do you think this fits with our focus on promoting building the metaverse as the next major opportunity?” he asked. “That’s not at odds with safety, but it’s a much different and more innovation-focused message.” Weeks later, Zuckerberg made a huge announcement: The company was changing its name to Meta in honor of its newest, most important priority.

zh.summary: The Verge通过检查Meta对儿童安全的处理方式，通过Mark Zuckerberg与顾问之间的私人对话，揭示了CEO关于优先考虑青少年保护还是元宇宙发展的矛盾立场。该文章质疑在持续的儿童安全争议中，公众对Meta动机的看法是否能够改变。

title: Apple’s first live music venue is opening beneath its UK headquarters
summary: Apple is opening Apple Music Hall, a 600-capacity live music venue beneath its European headquarters at London's Battersea Power Station, launching September 28th. The venue will host performances, recording sessions, and video broadcasts as part of Apple's expanded music ecosystem.
content:
The venue is opening below Battersea Power Station, also well recognized for featuring on the cover of Pink Floyd’s Animals album. | Image: Apple	

Apple is preparing to open a new "state-of-the-art" live music venue in the UK, a 600-capacity space for hosting performances, recording sessions, and video broadcasts. The venue, called Apple Music Hall, is located underneath Apple's European headquarters in London's iconic Battersea Power Station, and is set to open next week on September 28th. Details about the opening show have yet to be announced.

zh.title: Apple首个现场音乐场馆在其英国总部下方开业
zh.summary: Apple在其位于伦敦Battersea Power Station的欧洲总部下方开设Apple Music Hall，一个可容纳600人的现场音乐场馆，将于9月28日开放。该场馆将作为Apple拓展音乐生态系统的一部分，举办演出、录音会议和视频广播。

title: Morphotonics raises €40M to expand its display tech into data centers
summary: Display technology company Morphotonics has secured €40 million in funding from investors including 3M Ventures and Innovation Industries to expand its solutions into data center applications. The investment signals growing interest in optimizing display technology for enterprise infrastructure.
content: Deeptech company Morphotonics raises €40M from investors including 3M Ventures, Innovation Industries, BOM, and Invest-NL.

zh.title: Morphotonics融资4000万欧元将显示技术扩展至数据中心
zh.summary: 显示技术公司Morphotonics从包括3M Ventures和Innovation Industries在内的投资者那里获得了4000万欧元的融资，以将其解决方案扩展到数据中心应用。该投资表明业界对优化企业基础设施显示技术的兴趣日益增长。
